tags.name: Rockport Dive Site
tags.qa_note: Re-audited 2026-08-19, still unresolved. Found one possible lead: 2006 ScubaBoard thread 'Balayan Bay - beside Anilao' describes a 'Rockport' WRECK (40ft structure, 90-110ft/27-33m, tens of thousands of jacks, maya-maya, grouper) -- uncertain if same site, only 1 source, cannot meet 3-source threshold. Not reclassified. Site remains unvalidated.

tags.name: Basura
tags.qa_note: Depth corrected from 25m to 18m (sources: 3-18m). Rhinopias and wonderpus removed — not site-specific to Basura, attributed to other Anilao muck sites.

Cross placed by Fidel Ramos (confirmed); Pope JPII blessing claim unverified — removed from description. Depth range confirmed 5-30m; maxDepth 19m is conservative, real max closer to 30m at deeper sections.

RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: HALLUCINATION REMOVED -- 'rainbow runners, several species of rays, and occasionally whale shark ... reported in the wider area' was not supported by the cited primary source (asiadivesite.com), which lists only triggerfish, snappers, surgeonfish, jacks, anthias, turtles, and blue-ringed octopus. Removed manta/whale-shark/tuna/rainbow-runner claims. Depth (14-27m) and strong-current/neap-tide advice reconfirmed against asiadivesite.com directly.

RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: Found the markdown one-liner still read as unfixed template filler ('Sepok Wall is a wall dive site in Philippines Anilao, Asia.') despite this site being marked validated in the prior pass -- rewritten with specific content. Marine life section (frogfish, leaf fish, twin-spot lionfish, scorpionfish, Chromodoris nudibranchs) and the prior reef-shark removal note were already accurate and retained. Added missing Site Information fields (visibility, current, best time).

RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: Removed 'whitetip reef sharks patrol the boulders' -- not confirmed for this specific site in any source checked; whitetips are well-documented at other current-swept Anilao sites (Mainit Point, Dive & Trek) and this appears to have been misattributed in the previous pass. Eagle rays, mantas, sea turtles reconfirmed via ScubaDiverLife ('seen here frequently').
Depth corrected from 20m to 18m per philippinedives.com (5-18m range). Marine life updated to site-specifically confirmed species.

RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: Found the markdown one-liner still read as unfixed template filler ('Kirby's Rock is a wall dive site in Philippines Anilao, Asia.') despite this site being marked validated in the prior pass -- rewritten with specific content. Re-confirmed against fresh fetches of blueribbondivers.com and scubadiverlife.com: two pinnacles + canyon, Colochirus robustus sea cucumbers, moray eels, pygmy seahorses, dragon shrimp, frogfish, current shifting mid-dive all reconfirmed. Added missing Site Information fields (visibility, current, best time) that were absent from the markdown.

Black sand and geothermal features confirmed. Marine life corrected — broadclub cuttlefish and bobbit worms removed as not site-specifically sourced. Confirmed: frogfish, seahorses, wonderpus, ghost pipefish, Coleman shrimp, nudibranchs.

RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: SITE TYPE RECLASSIFIED muck -> drift. The previous QA pass left this site described as a deep muck/critter dive (rhinopias, bobbit worms, hairy frogfish, mandarin fish) despite its own cited sources (wannadive.net, anilaodiving.com, dive-the-world.com) not actually supporting that content -- re-fetching dive-the-world.com (one of the original 3 sources) directly contradicts it: 'Mainit Point is typical of Anilao, consisting of a current-swept boulder-strewn slope' with giant trevally, whitetip reef sharks, dog-toothed tuna, great barracuda, and a 7-8m cave with resting whitetips. Independently corroborated by a ScubaBoard thread grouping Mainit Point with Beatrice Rock and Bahura as a strong-current site, and by philippinedives.com noting 'tidal currents demand intermediate [+] skills' at Mainit Point. 3 independent sources now support drift/current-swept reef classification with pelagics; muck-themed marine life claims removed as unsupported by any source found. Difficulty kept at Advanced given consistent strong-current descriptions.

RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: DEPTH CONFLICT FOUND -- existing data says 16m, but PADI's official dive site listing says max 40m (131ft) and AnilaoDiving.com (operator) says 5-30m. Documented as a source conflict in markdown rather than silently picking one number; depth field left at 16m (shallow reef-top zone) pending resolution -- treat as approximate. Stripped PADI's generic species checklist (included 'Sharks, Whales, Dolphins' -- reads as regional template, not site-specific reporting). Removed unconfirmed pygmy seahorse and turtle claims that could not be traced to a site-specific source.
Blue-ringed octopus confirmed for night dives. Ambon scorpionfish and specific species corrected — only species with site-specific confirmation retained.
Depth 10m confirmed. Ghost pipefish and mantis shrimp not independently sourced to Dead Palm specifically — marked as regional in description.

Site type muck confirmed. Wonderpus and harlequin shrimp confirmed at this site per uwphotographyguide. Rhinopias confirmed at Anilao muck sites including this area. Flamboyant cuttlefish claim retained as regionally confirmed.

tags.name: Bethlehem
tags.qa_note: Location confirmed: entrance to passage between Marikaban and Caban Islands. Depth 3-20m confirmed. Fire urchin shrimps confirmed. Re-audited from single-source to 3-source.

tags.name: Caban Cove
tags.qa_note: Site type corrected from reef to drift — McFadyen confirms current-assisted drift dive. Niger triggerfish (tens of thousands) confirmed. Blue ribbon eel confirmed (1 observed per McFadyen). Giant anglerfish confirmed.

tags.name: Dari Laut
tags.qa_note: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19 (wreck deep research, 4 sources): Confirmed floating hotel-casino-restaurant identity across 4 independent sources (McFadyen, ScubaDiverLife, PuertoParrot, PaparazSea). Decade conflict: PuertoParrot says 1970s, PaparazSea says 'late 70s or early 80s' -- documented as conflict in markdown, not resolved. Cause: fire, confirmed multiple sources; insurance-arson is a recurring LOCAL RUMOR per 2 independent sources (McFadyen, PaparazSea), both explicitly framed as unconfirmed rumor, not fact -- no 'mysterious circumstances' filler used. Depth conflict found: McFadyen (first-hand field log) reports 12-25m; PuertoParrot reports max 37m -- documented as conflict, McFadyen's field-report treated as most reliable. Added Mandarin fish + Crab Eye Gobies (PuertoParrot, site-specific). No vessel name/build date/tonnage/dimensions found in any source -- correctly stated as unknown. Noted but excluded: anilaodiving.com describes site instead as a deliberately-sunk barge/concrete-block artificial reef with a generic uncorroborated species list -- treated as unreliable template content, not used.

tags.name: Olympic Point
tags.qa_note: Hairy anglerfish confirmed (tiny orange specimen). Spiny devilfish confirmed (2 observed). Mushroom coral pipefish confirmed (in anemones, not on mushroom coral per McFadyen — name is misleading). Ribbon eels (juvenile) confirmed. Site-specific marine life verified.

tags.name: Sun View
tags.qa_note: Pygmy seahorses at 24m on gorgonias confirmed. Octopus and mantis shrimp confirmed. Nudibranchs confirmed. No anemones seen by McFadyen — removed from description.

tags.name: Mainit Bubble Springs
tags.qa_note: Wall ~70m long confirmed by McFadyen. Wall depth 22-30m confirmed. Banded sea snake confirmed. Anglerfish, leaf fish, batfish, turtles confirmed. Hot spring bubbles confirmed geothermal (volcano ~35km away).

tags.name: Mainit Corner
tags.qa_note: Bommie 600m from resort confirmed. Nembrotha nudibranchs confirmed. Harlequin shrimp confirmed. Pygmy seahorse confirmed. Lionfish, sweetlips, boxfish confirmed.

tags.name: Buceo House Reef
tags.qa_note: Three anglerfish on single dive confirmed. Sea moths confirmed. Squat lobsters confirmed. Mantis shrimp confirmed. Site-specific marine life verified against McFadyen primary source.

tags.name: Agahuta
tags.qa_note: Two giant anglerfish confirmed. Thousands of redtooth triggerfish confirmed. Featherstar shrimps confirmed. Hairy squat lobsters confirmed. Marine life retained — all site-specifically sourced.

tags.name: Aphols Point
tags.qa_note: Pygmy seahorse on gorgonia confirmed. Harlequin shrimp confirmed (light-coloured). Funeral jorunna nudibranch confirmed. Orangutan crab in anemone confirmed. Spotted stingrays confirmed. White anglerfish confirmed. Banded sea snake confirmed. All site-specific.
